verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships an official CLI whose main entry point is the `ros2` command. Its documented sub-commands cover introspecting nodes, topics and services, publishing and echoing (`ros2 topic pub`), recording bags, running `doctor`, tracing and managing security keystores. It is built on an extensible framework with a background daemon for fast graph queries, and a community user notes they end up wanting the CLI tools. Missing for 10: any documented AI/agent-oriented affordances (e.g. machine-readable/JSON output modes or agent integration guidance), and stronger independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI-native workflows.
